answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The haven of work and the karst of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tide to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
